name: Plate Neck Extension
steps: Lie facedown on a bench with your head off the edge, holding a light plate over a towel behind your head.
Keep both hands resting lightly on the plate solely to stabilize it in position.
Extend your neck smoothly upward against the plate's resistance until your head lifts cleanly within a comfortable range.
Lower your head slowly back down under strict control without letting the weight pull your neck abruptly.
tips: Progress weight conservatively and move strictly under control to protect your cervical spine.
Keep your torso flat on the bench rather than lifting your chest to raise the plate.
